predecessors.name: Byzantine Empire
predecessors.text: the city of Thessalonica, governed for the regency in Constantinople by Theodore Synadenos, whose supporters 'were ousted' by the people

successors.name: Byzantine Empire
successors.text: the city of Thessalonica, entered by John VI Kantakouzenos in 1350

ledger.x: 1350: the Zealots' commune ends with Kantakouzenos's entry into Thessalonica, the only Macedonian city still Byzantine after the Serbian conquests of 1345 onward (civil-war page).

wars.name: Byzantine civil war of 1341-1347 (Thessalonica)
wars.outcome: The Zealots hold Thessalonica against both the regency (Apokaukos and his son John) and Kantakouzenos, who 'camped outside the city' c.

wars.name: Kantakouzenos's reconquest of Thessalonica
wars.outcome: The city rises against the Zealots at the end of 1349; Kantakouzenos enters in 1350 with John V and Palamas.

certainty.note: Only the city of Thessalonica is named by the pages; its hinterland is Cliopatria's disc, not a documented boundary.
